Proposed metabolic pathway of lactulose metabolismin NTS was constructed based on differential gene expression analysis, functional prediction, and cellular localization

The proposed metabolic pathway of lactulose metabolismin NTS was constructed based on differential gene expression analysis, functional prediction, and cellular localization. Genes upregulated in response to lactulose are circled in green, and their product/enzyme names are shown as blue text. Genes showing higher logCPM expression in the presence of lactulose are highlighted with orange circles; however, these genes do not meet all the defined thresholds for differential expression (logFC = ±1 and logCPM = 3.5). The figure was created with Biorender (biorender.com)
